name: engineering-board
description: The board is the database: a git-committed kanban board your AI agents run and remember — distributed as a Claude Code plugin and an MCP server.

plugins.name: engineering-board
plugins.description: Git-committed pattern intelligence for engineering agents. Stable P### identities, explicit foreground promotion, and a deterministic provenance-linked graph connect recurring findings across domains while Markdown remains canonical. Includes passive capture, durable learnings, atomic claims, an optional tdd->review->validate proof loop, and a zero-dependency 15-tool MCP server over the same board format.
